test_title: PYST 62: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Coarse
solution:
The correct answer is **Crude.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Synonym** refers to words which are **similar in meaning.**
 
• The word **"coarse**" means "**rough**", or **which is not very pleasant.**
 
• Therefore, the correct synonym will be** crude.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Happy**" refers to a very **pleasurable situation where one enjoys something**.
 
• **"Kind"** means very **gentle or of a very soft nature**.
 
• **"Polite"** means** humble, who always behave in a very gentle manner**.
